annotations.title: Get the user's Stackcut savings plan

description: Use only when the user gives you a Stackcut agent code (it starts with sca_; they copy it from 'Send to my agent' on stackcut.io). Returns their own savings plan: every subscription with its verdict, the proven saving, the proof (receipts, card charges or a sourced price), steps and checks. Walk them through it from the biggest proven saving down and ask before any cancel, purchase or sign-up. The code is read-only and expires. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses): don't send personal data or secrets.
